v1.feedback: The linked idea promised a 'delightful, tasteful swerve' but delivers a gimmicky timed event (8s wait, 2s reversal) that you miss if you look away. The reversal mechanics (negative dt, color invert, camera flip) are technically correct but feel arbitrary—nothing about 'abracadabra' suggests time-reversal as a transformation. The base Lorenz is well-executed (good palette, readable butterfly form, proper framing) but the 'surprise' should have been baked into the spatial/color structure from frame 0, not a scripted cutscene. Consider: bifurcate the attractor into two mirrored lobes with different color families, or make particles spiral into/out of a vanishing point continuously—magic as spatial logic, not a timer.
